entries.quote: patients with this mutation pattern had a higher response rate (83% versus 29%)
entries.cited_text: Among the 19 patients, 12 had complex mutations with the classical mutation pattern (L858R or deletion in exon 19). When compared with those without the classical mutation pattern, patients with this mutation pattern had a higher response rate (83% versus 29%), longer progression-free survival duration (median, 12.7 months versus 4.9 months), and longer overall survival time (median, 24.7 months versus 12.3 months) after gefitinib treatment.

checker.reason: The study reports that patients with the classical mutation pattern (including L858R) had significantly higher response rates and longer survival after gefitinib treatment compared to those without.
